local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff against the library-new-request review signals. The scaffold placeholder is replaced by Html5EntitiesTest in the separate org_commonmark.commonmark package, which drives Parser, HtmlRenderer and TextContentRenderer to resolve named character references in paragraph text, link destinations and titles, link reference definitions and fenced code info strings; there is no native skip, error-swallowing catch, version-pinned assertion, build or run flag, or legacy metadata file, and build.gradle and settings.gradle are unchanged. The only dynamic-access call site, the entities.txt resource lookup in Html5Entities, went from 0/1 to 1/1 covered in the GraalVM 25.0 dynamic-access report; the latest GraalVM used for the statistics no longer tracks that constant-name lookup, so stats.json reports 0/0. The tracing agent recorded one library metadata entry and no test-only entries, and no scenario was dropped. All three Forge native lanes, metadata and style checks, and statistics validation pass.
